task: Implement the LLM usage ledger writer FOUNDATION (Slice 1) in packages/main/src per docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-llm-usage-ledger-execution-plan.md: record types + schema validator, append-only hash-chained writer to .lattice/usage/llm-usage.jsonl, correlation-id generation, raw-content/secret rejection, runtime-artifact registration, opt-in flag (default OFF), informational summary reader, and a wired smoke test. No provider wiring, no estimate path, no budget enforcement, no Authority — deferred to later slices.
outcome: Running the new smoke (npm --prefix packages/main run test:usage-ledger, or via the suite) prints all-green: the validator accepts a valid four-field record and REJECTS a record that stores totalTokens, carries raw prompt/transcript/secret/API-key/auth-header, or is malformed; the append-only writer creates .lattice/usage/llm-usage.jsonl and chains previousRecordHash->recordHash across multiple appends (chain verifies); correlation ids stay stable across an attempt's records with a monotonic sequence and working supersedesRecordIds; with the opt-in flag OFF the writer is a no-op and NO file is created; the ledger path classifies as gitignored + materialHash=exclude + volatile + repairableTrackedArtifact; and the summary reader derives total = inputTokens + outputTokens + cacheCreationInputTokens + cacheReadInputTokens, selects the latest non-superseded record per ledgerCallId+attemptId (never double-counting superseded estimates), and reports unavailable/null as unknown (never 0). `npm --prefix packages/main run build` is clean.
